metadata.title: Obiljon Rakhimov — Full-Stack Developer
metadata.description: Portfolio of Obiljon Rakhimov, a full-stack developer focused on TypeScript, Rust, AI-driven software and microservices.

hero.hero: I build fast, type-safe web products.
hero.intro: React, Next.js, NestJS and Rust (Actix-web) — from secure APIs to polished interfaces, with a focus on AI-driven software and microservices.

about.bio: I’m a detail-oriented full-stack developer who enjoys working across both the front end and the back end. I build scalable web applications with React.js, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS and Rust, and I want to contribute to innovative projects in AI-driven software and microservices architecture.

experienceItems.title: Trainee, AI Software Team
experienceItems.description: Built JWT-secured REST APIs in Rust (Actix-web), type-safe forms with Zod and Chart.js dashboards for AI-powered apps.

experienceItems.title: Intern
experienceItems.description: Web development with JavaScript, HTML and CSS, plus code reviews and a Git/GitHub workflow.
